info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 47h online + 3h offline + 1h Final exam + 99h self study
info.description: The Art of Sales Specialization is designed to make you more effective and efficient as you pursue your sales goals. Understand how to stand out in the crowd, attract customers, and build support for your initiatives within your company. Knowing how to “get to yes” is a crucial skill that can improve many facets of your life. Prepare to be tested, taught, and transformed as you learn to locate new customers and get great results.
info.studentTasks:
1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin.

2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assignments... as required

3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct

3. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded)

4. Communicate and discuss in forum

5. Attend off-line sessions in the Campus (Optional)

6. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
info.note:
1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

2) Theoretical Exam (TE)

3) Final Result (FR) =min (10, TE + Bonus)

4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5

clos.loDetails: Make you as efficient and effective in selling as possible
Run high-impact meetings, anticipate and handle sales objections, tell powerful stories and to give and receive performance feedback
Give great presentations with dashing style and self-confidence, ask the looming closing question, develop your brand and go above and beyond for your clients
Review the insights and use the tools to curate your Sales Toolkit
